preconditions.description: The number of test cases t must be between 1 and 10,000.
The number of columns m in each test case must be between 1 and 100,000.

preconditions.expression: all(1 <= a[i][j] <= 10**4 for i in range(2) for j in range(m))
preconditions.description: Each cell in the matrix must contain between 1 and 10,000 coins.

postconditions.description: The output must be the score of the game for each test case.
The score must be a non-negative integer.
The score is the maximum coins Bob can collect after Alice's optimal path.
